description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10), a retrieval metric, as it varies with the number of queries used during inference, denoted as S. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” spans from 2 to 10, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2, and is presented on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” ranges from 33.0 to 36.5 and also uses a linear scale. The plot contains six distinct lines, each representing a different retrieval strategy: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line), “DPR w/ gold” (yellow circular markers with a solid line), “DPR w/ top-1” (green circular markers with a solid line), “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple circular markers with a dashed line), “DPR w/ random” (blue circular markers with a dashed line), and “DPR w/ curriculum” (red circular markers with a dashed line). The “DPR w/ top-1” line starts at 34.5 when S=2 and rises steeply to 36.5 at S=10. The “DPR w/ curriculum” line begins at 35.1 when S=2 and remains relatively flat, hovering around 35.8, before slightly declining to 35.7 at S=10. The “DPR w/ gold” line starts at 34.0 when S=2 and increases steadily to 35.0 at S=10. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” line begins at 35.0 when S=2 and gradually declines to 34.5 at S=10. The “DPR w/ random” line starts at 34.9 when S=2 and remains nearly constant around 35.2 until S=10. The “DPR w/o query” line remains flat at 34.0 across the entire range of S from 2 to 10.
